(e) Monitoring of changes in soil micro-biological communities.
The implementation of current proposals to establish baseline monitoring stations at Marion Island and Iles Kerguelen should be encouraged.
SCAR could play a useful rôle in the co-ordination of monitoring programmes and ensuring that the facilities are available for the determination of the recommended parameters.
28 It is pointed out that many Antarctic biologists are in a position to collect biological materials for monitoring programmes if such material is required.
It is emphasized that Specially Protected Areas (especially any which might be designated "scientific reserves") can serve as a yardstick against which to measure biological changes. Programmes comparing a series of biological parameters, between disturbed areas and similar areas in these reserves should be encouraged.
